title: Tensor product distributes over a binary product of algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and let $A$, $B$, and $C$ be commutative $R$-algebras [lem-weil-pbc-algebra-tensor-pushout-universal-property], with tensor products formed as in [def-weil-module-base-change]. Then the canonical map induces an $R$-algebra isomorphism $A\otimes_R(B\times C)\cong(A\otimes_RB)\times(A\otimes_RC)$, sending $a\otimes(b,c)$ to $(a\otimes b,a\otimes c)$.
